_scope: Curated v1 subset using the full-book schema. Every field a full catalog needs is present; only the number of rows is reduced. Adding rows later needs no schema change.

completePackageBudgets.fashionNote: The 800eb may ONLY buy Fashion or Fashionware. Anything unspent is lost.

_rules.humanityLossAtCreation: At Character Generation, Humanity Loss is the PRESET flat number. The dice in parentheses apply only AFTER creation. Do not roll HL during chargen.
_rules.installNote: Installation surgery is always included at no extra charge, including at Character Generation.

cyberarm.notes: Ships with a Standard Hand that costs no Humanity and no slot.

cyberleg.notes: Ships with a Standard Foot that costs no Humanity and no slot.

optionSlots.nonFoundational: Fashionware, Internal Cyberware, and External Cyberware have no foundational piece, but a Character may still only implant 7 Option Slots worth of each category.
optionSlots.default: Unless otherwise marked, a cyberware option consumes 1 Option Slot in its foundation.
optionSlots._resolves: This closes the previously-open question about foundation slot counts.

_rules.armorNote: One worn armor per location (head / body / shield). Track current SP separately from base SP so ablation works in play.
_rules.stackingNote: Benefits from multiple installations of the same cyberware do not stack unless stated.

weapons.name: Heavy SMG
weapons.notes: Autofire (3), Suppressive Fire

weapons.name: Shotgun
weapons.notes: Shotgun Shell

weapons.notes: Autofire (4), Suppressive Fire

weapons.name: Bows & Crossbows
weapons.notes: Arrows

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher
weapons.notes: Explosive

weapons.name: Rocket Launcher
weapons.notes: Explosive

weapons.name: Air Pistol
weapons.notes: Exotic Medium Pistol firing paintballs (no damage). Filled with Acid, each hit lowers the shot location's armor SP by 1. Cannot cause Critical Injuries. Great for taking someone alive.

weapons.name: Battleglove
weapons.notes: Exotic heavy gauntlet with 3 Cyberarm option slots you can access while worn. Putting it on or taking it off is an Action. Cannot be concealed.

weapons.name: Constitution Arms Hurricane Assault Weapon
weapons.notes: Exotic 2 ROF Shotgun. No Aimed Shots. 16-shot drum, reload takes two Actions. Requires BODY 11+ to fire unmounted.

weapons.name: Dartgun
weapons.notes: Exotic Very Heavy Pistol that loads only Non-Basic Arrow ammunition, in an 8-round clip. Reloads like a Very Heavy Pistol.

weapons.name: Flamethrower
weapons.notes: Exotic Shotgun fired with Heavy Weapons. Fires only incendiary shotgun shells; ignited targets take 4 HP per turn until they put themselves out. No Aimed Shots, no Critical Injuries.

weapons.name: Kendachi Mono-Three
weapons.notes: Excellent Quality Two-Handed Exotic Very Heavy Melee weapon. With the correct biometric key, ignores armor entirely below SP11. A vibrating crystal katana; a laser can be set in the hilt for a neon glow.

weapons.name: Malorian Arms 3516
weapons.notes: Excellent Quality Exotic Very Heavy Pistol dealing 5d6 on a single shot, with a permanently installed Smartgun Link (needs Interface Plugs or a Subdermal Grip). Rare and coveted.

weapons.name: Microwaver
weapons.notes: Exotic Very Heavy Pistol. No damage: on a hit the target must beat a DV15 Cybertech Check or the GM shuts down two of their cyberware or electronics for a minute. Battery: 8 shots, spare packs 50eb.

weapons.name: Militech "Cowboy" U-56 Grenade Launcher
weapons.notes: Exotic 2 ROF Grenade Launcher holding 4 grenades and able to fire all Grenade Ammunition. Reload takes two Actions. Requires BODY 11+ to fire unmounted.

weapons.name: Rhinemetall EMG-86 Railgun
weapons.notes: Exotic Assault Rifle fired with Heavy Weapons. No Autofire, no Aimed Shots. Holds 4 shots and ignores armor below SP11. Reload takes two Actions. Requires BODY 11+ unmounted.

weapons.name: Shrieker
weapons.notes: Exotic Very Heavy Pistol. No damage: on a hit the target must beat a DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or suffer Damaged Ear. Firing it without ear protection damages your own ear. Battery: 8 shots.

weapons.name: Stun Baton
weapons.notes: One-Handed Exotic Medium Melee weapon. Non-lethal: a target it would drop below 1 HP is left Unconscious at 1 HP instead. No Critical Injuries, no armor ablation.

weapons.name: Stun Gun
weapons.notes: Exotic Heavy Pistol. Non-lethal: a target it would drop below 1 HP is left Unconscious at 1 HP instead. No Critical Injuries, no armor ablation. Battery: 8 shots, spare packs 50eb.

weapons.name: Tsunami Arms Helix
weapons.notes: Exotic Assault Rifle fired only with Autofire, no single shot or Aimed Shots. Holds 40 rounds and burns 20 per attack; on a hit, 2d6 multiplied by how much you beat the DV (max x5). Requires BODY 11+ unmounted.

armor.name: Kevlar
armor.notes: Can be made into clothes, vests, jackets, suits.

armor.name: Light Armorjack
armor.notes: Kevlar and plastic mesh in the weave.

armor.name: Bodyweight Suit
armor.notes: Stores a Cyberdeck and supports Interface Plugs.

armor.name: Bulletproof Shield
armor.notes: 10 HP reduced by damage. Always occupies one arm.

ammunition.name: Basic Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Grenades and Rockets are not sold as Basic ammunition.

ammunition.name: Armor-Piercing Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Ablate armor by 2 instead of 1 whenever you would ablate armor.

ammunition.name: Biotoxin Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. A meat target must beat a DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or take 3d6 straight to HP, armor unablated.

ammunition.name: EMP Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. Target must beat a DV15 Cybertech Check or the GM shuts down two pieces of their cyberware or carried electronics for 1 minute.

ammunition.name: Expansive Ammunition
ammunition.notes: On a Foreign Object Critical Injury, the target rolls a second Critical Injury and suffers it too (no bonus damage).

ammunition.name: Flashbang Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. Target must beat a DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or suffer Damaged Eye and Damaged Ear for a minute.

ammunition.name: Incendiary Ammunition
types: Arrows, Bullets, Grenades, and Shotgun Shells
ammunition.notes: Deal damage through armor and the target ignites: 2 HP at the end of each of their turns until they spend an Action to put it out. Does not stack.

ammunition.name: Poison Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. A meat target must beat a DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or take 2d6 straight to HP, armor unablated.

ammunition.name: Rubber Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Cannot cause Critical Injuries and cannot ablate armor. Never drops a target with more than 1 HP below 1 HP.

ammunition.name: Sleep Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. A meat target must beat a DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or drop Prone and Unconscious for a minute (or until woken or damaged).

ammunition.name: Smart Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Requires Targeting Scope cyberware to fire. A single shot that misses by 4 or less gets a second chance to hit at +10 on the die.

ammunition.name: Smoke Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Fills a 10m by 10m area with smoke for a minute on impact. Tasks attempted in it take a -4.

ammunition.name: Teargas Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. A target with meat eyes must beat a DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or suffer Damaged Eye for a minute.

cyberware.name: Biomonitor
cyberware.notes: Subdermal vitals readout. Links to an Agent.

cyberware.name: Chemskin
cyberware.notes: Permanently changes skin hue. +2 Personal Grooming with Techhair.

cyberware.name: EMP Threading
cyberware.notes: Silver circuit-pattern lines across the body.

cyberware.name: Light Tattoo
cyberware.notes: Projects colored tattoos under the skin. +2 Wardrobe & Style with three or more.

cyberware.name: Shift Tacts
cyberware.notes: Color-changing implanted lenses.

cyberware.name: Skinwatch
cyberware.notes: Subdermally implanted LED watch.

cyberware.name: Techhair
cyberware.notes: Color-light-emitting artificial hair. +2 Personal Grooming with Chemskin.

cyberware.name: Neural Link
cyberware.notes: Required for Neuralware and Subdermal Grip. Has 5 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Braindance Recorder
cyberware.notes: Records the user's experiences to a memory chip or external device.

cyberware.name: Chipware Socket
cyberware.notes: A socket in the back of the neck. Required to use Chipware.

cyberware.name: Interface Plugs
cyberware.notes: Plugs in the wrist or head to connect to machines.

cyberware.name: Kerenzikov
cyberware.notes: Speedware. +2 Initiative. Only one piece of Speedware at a time.

cyberware.name: Sandevistan
cyberware.notes: Speedware. Activate for +3 Initiative for one minute, 1 hour cooldown. Only one Speedware at a time.

cyberware.name: Chemical Analyzer
cyberware.notes: Chipware. Tests substances against a database. Requires a Chipware Socket.

cyberware.name: Memory Chip
cyberware.notes: Data storage the user's cyberware can read and write.

cyberware.name: Olfactory Boost
cyberware.notes: Chipware. Track by scent with the Tracking Skill. Requires a Chipware Socket.

cyberware.name: Pain Editor
cyberware.notes: Chipware. Ignore Seriously Wounded penalties. Requires a Chipware Socket.

cyberware.name: Skill Chip
cyberware.notes: Chipware. Grants a Skill at Level 3. (x2)-cost Skill chips cost 1,000eb. Requires a Chipware Socket.

cyberware.name: Tactile Boost
cyberware.notes: Chipware. Detect motion within 20m/yd through a surface. Requires a Chipware Socket.

cyberware.name: Cybereye
cyberware.notes: Artificial eye. Each has 3 Option Slots. Some options must be paired across two Cybereyes.

cyberware.name: Anti-Dazzle
cyberware.notes: Immune to flashes of light. Requires two Cybereyes, paired.

cyberware.name: Chyron
cyberware.notes: Projects a subscreen into the field of vision. Requires a Cybereye.

cyberware.name: Color Shift
cyberware.notes: Unlimited color and pattern changes for the eye. Requires a Cybereye.

cyberware.name: Dartgun
cyberware.notes: Single-shot Dartgun concealed in the eye. Requires a Cybereye, takes 3 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Image Enhance
cyberware.notes: +2 Perception, Lip Reading, Conceal/Reveal Object. Requires two Cybereyes, paired.

cyberware.name: Low Light / Infrared / UV
cyberware.notes: Ignore darkness, smoke, fog. Requires two Cybereyes, paired, 2 slots per eye.

cyberware.name: MicroOptics
cyberware.notes: 400x magnification. Requires a Cybereye.

cyberware.name: MicroVideo
cyberware.notes: Records audio and video to a Memory Chip or Agent. Requires a Cybereye, 2 slots.

cyberware.name: Radiation Detector
cyberware.notes: Displays radiation within 100m/yd as a blue glow. Requires a Cybereye.

cyberware.name: Targeting Scope
cyberware.notes: +1 to Aimed Shot Checks. Requires a Cybereye.

cyberware.name: TeleOptics
cyberware.notes: See detail up to 800m/yd. +1 to Aimed Shots at 51m/yd+. Requires a Cybereye.

cyberware.name: Virtuality
cyberware.notes: Projects cyberspace imagery over the user's view. Requires two Cybereyes, paired.

cyberware.name: Cyberaudio Suite
cyberware.notes: Has 3 Option Slots. Cannot install more than one.

cyberware.name: Amplified Hearing
cyberware.notes: +2 Perception for hearing Checks. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Audio Recorder
cyberware.notes: Records audio to a Memory Chip or Agent. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Bug Detector
cyberware.notes: Beeps within 2m/yd of a listening device. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Homing Tracer
cyberware.notes: Follow a linked tracer up to 1 mile. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Internal Agent
cyberware.notes: A fully functional Agent installed internally. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Level Damper
cyberware.notes: Immune to loud noises. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Radio Communicator
cyberware.notes: Radio communication, 1 mile range. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Radio Scanner / Music Player
cyberware.notes: Plays music or tunes into broadcasts within 1 mile. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Radar Detector
cyberware.notes: Beeps if an active radar beam is within 100m/yd. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Scrambler / Descrambler
cyberware.notes: Scramble outgoing and descramble incoming communications. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: Voice Stress Analyzer
cyberware.notes: +2 Human Perception and Interrogation. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite.

cyberware.name: AudioVox
cyberware.notes: Voice synthesizer. +2 Acting and Play Instrument when singing.

cyberware.name: Contraceptive Implant
cyberware.notes: Prevents undesired pregnancy.

cyberware.name: Enhanced Antibodies
cyberware.notes: Heals BODY x2 per day of rest after stabilization.

cyberware.name: Cybersnake
cyberware.notes: Esophagus-mounted Very Heavy Melee Weapon. Can be concealed.

cyberware.name: Gills
cyberware.notes: Breathe underwater.

cyberware.name: Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace
cyberware.notes: +2 BODY (max 10). Changes HP, Wound Threshold, and Death Save.

cyberware.name: Independent Air Supply
cyberware.notes: 30 minutes of oxygen. Refills in 1 hour from ambient air.

cyberware.name: Midnight Lady™ Sexual Implant
cyberware.notes: Sexual implant.

cyberware.name: Mr. Studd™ Sexual Implant
cyberware.notes: Sexual implant.

cyberware.name: Nasal Filters
cyberware.notes: Immune to toxic gases, fumes, and similar dangers.

cyberware.name: Radar / Sonar Implant
cyberware.notes: Scans terrain within 50m/yd. Cannot scan through cover.

cyberware.name: Toxin Binders
cyberware.notes: +2 Resist Torture/Drugs.

cyberware.name: Vampyres
cyberware.notes: Excellent Quality Light Melee Weapon in the mouth. Can add Poison or Biotoxin.

cyberware.name: Hidden Holster
cyberware.notes: Stores a concealable weapon inside the body.

cyberware.name: Skin Weave
cyberware.notes: Body and head armored at SP7. Does not stack with worn Armor. Ablates.

cyberware.name: Subdermal Armor
cyberware.notes: Body and head armored at SP11. Does not stack with worn Armor. Ablates.

cyberware.name: Subdermal Pocket
cyberware.notes: A small storage space under the skin with a RealSkinn zipper.

cyberware.name: Cyberarm
cyberware.notes: Replacement arm with 4 Option Slots. Ships with a Standard Hand that costs no Humanity and no slot.

cyberware.name: Standard Hand
cyberware.notes: Standard cybernetic hand. Free and slotless with a Cyberarm; can also be installed in a meat arm.

cyberware.name: Big Knucks
cyberware.notes: Armored knuckles. Medium Melee Weapon. Can be the only cyberware in a meat arm.

cyberware.name: Cyberdeck (Cyberarm)
cyberware.notes: A Cyberdeck installed in a Cyberarm. Requires a Cyberarm, takes 3 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Grapple Hand
cyberware.notes: Fires the hand on a grapple line up to 30m/yd. Requires a Cyberarm.

cyberware.name: Medscanner (Cyberarm)
cyberware.notes: +2 First Aid and Paramedic. Requires a Cyberarm, takes 2 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Popup Grenade Launcher
cyberware.notes: Single-shot Grenade Launcher in a Cyberarm. Requires a Cyberarm, takes 2 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Popup Melee Weapon
cyberware.notes: A Light/Medium/Heavy Melee Weapon in a Cyberarm. Requires a Cyberarm, takes 2 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Popup Shield
cyberware.notes: A Bulletproof Shield in a Cyberarm. Requires a Cyberarm, takes 3 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Popup Ranged Weapon
cyberware.notes: A One-Handed Ranged Weapon in a Cyberarm. Requires a Cyberarm, takes 2 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Quick Change Mount
cyberware.notes: Remove or install a Cyberarm as an Action. Requires a Cyberarm.

cyberware.name: Rippers
cyberware.notes: Carbo-glass claws. Medium Melee Weapon. Can be the only cyberware in a meat arm.

cyberware.name: Scratchers
cyberware.notes: Carbo-glass fingernails. Light Melee Weapon. Can be the only cyberware in a meat arm.

cyberware.name: Shoulder Cam
cyberware.notes: Concealable shoulder-mounted camera. Requires a Cyberarm, takes 2 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Slice 'N Dice
cyberware.notes: Monofilament whip in the thumb. Medium Melee Weapon. Can be the only cyberware in a meat arm.

cyberware.name: Subdermal Grip
cyberware.notes: Use a Smartgun without an Interface Plug. Requires a Neural Link. Can be the only cyberware in a meat arm.

cyberware.name: Techscanner (Cyberarm)
cyberware.notes: +2 to several TECH Skills. Requires a Cyberarm, takes 2 Option Slots.

cyberware.name: Tool Hand
cyberware.notes: Built-in screwdriver, wrench, drill, and more. Can be the only cyberware in a meat arm.

cyberware.name: Wolvers
cyberware.notes: Long knuckle claws. Heavy Melee Weapon. Can be the only cyberware in a meat arm.

cyberware.name: Cyberleg
cyberware.notes: Replacement leg with 3 Option Slots. Ships with a Standard Foot. Most options must be paired across two Cyberlegs.

cyberware.name: Standard Foot
cyberware.notes: Standard cybernetic foot. Free and slotless with a Cyberleg; can also be installed in a meat leg.

cyberware.name: Grip Foot
cyberware.notes: Negates climbing movement penalty. Requires two Cyberlegs, paired.

cyberware.name: Jump Booster
cyberware.notes: Negates jumping movement penalty. Requires two Cyberlegs, paired, 2 slots.

cyberware.name: Skate Foot
cyberware.notes: Built-in inline skates. +6m/yd on a Run Action. Requires two Cyberlegs, paired.

cyberware.name: Talon Foot
cyberware.notes: Foot blade. Light Melee Weapon. Can be the only cyberware in a meat leg.

cyberware.name: Web Foot
cyberware.notes: Negates swimming movement penalty. Requires two Cyberlegs, paired.

cyberware.name: Hardened Shielding
cyberware.notes: Cyberlimb immune to EMP and non-Black ICE effects. Requires a Cyberarm or Cyberleg.

cyberware.name: Plastic Covering
cyberware.notes: Colored plastic coating for a Cyberlimb. Requires a Cyberlimb, takes no Option Slot.

cyberware.name: Realskinn™ Covering
cyberware.notes: Artificial-skin coating for a Cyberlimb. Requires a Cyberlimb, takes no Option Slot.

cyberware.name: Superchrome® Covering
cyberware.notes: Shiny metallic coating. +2 Wardrobe & Style. Requires a Cyberlimb, takes no Option Slot.

cyberware.name: Artificial Shoulder Mount
cyberware.notes: Mount two extra Cyberarms below the first set.

cyberware.name: Implanted Linear Frame ß (Beta)
cyberware.notes: Increases BODY to 14. Requires BODY 8 and two Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace.

cyberware.name: Implanted Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma)
cyberware.notes: Increases BODY to 12. Requires BODY 6 and Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace.

cyberware.name: MultiOptic Mount
cyberware.notes: Mount up to five additional Cybereyes.

cyberware.name: Sensor Array
cyberware.notes: Install up to five additional Cyberaudio Options. Requires a Cyberaudio Suite but takes no Cyberaudio slot.

_scopeNote: Weapons (standard and Exotic), armor, the full ammunition-type table, the full gear list, the fashion price grid, and a curated cyberware set. Covers Night Market shopping at Character Generation. Weapon Attachments are an in-play upgrade system, handled separately.

fashion._note: Fashion is priced per garment slot per style. A character buys individual pieces (e.g. Leisurewear Jacket at 100eb), which is how the printed Streetrat/Edgerunner outfit strings decompose.
fashion._budgetRule: Fashion and Fashionware share the separate 800eb Complete Package budget. Unspent fashion money is LOST.
